source_row.stem: A hospital with Magnet designation must periodically reapply to maintain this status, and a newer nurse assumes this designation, once earned, probably just stays in place permanently with no further action needed. This reapplication cycle is instead generally:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Every 20 years, which is far longer than the actual interval this designation requires for reapplication","B":"Never required after initial designation, similar to what the newer nurse is currently assuming about how this status is maintained","C":"Every four years, requiring demonstration of continued excellence, rather than a one-time achievement as the newer nurse is currently assuming","D":"Determined randomly with no set cycle, contrary to the defined, regular reapplication cycle this designation actually requires"}}
source_row.rationale: Magnet designation requires periodic reapplication, generally every four years, requiring the organization to demonstrate continued excellence in nursing practice and outcomes.
